main_text.p: * Ebnol Athir.{*} لا يقبل الله صلاة بغير طهور * Non accipit Deus pre-ces absque mundatione, seu lotione & مفتاح الصلوة Orationis clavis est mundisics. Unde & طهارة الطهور vocatur lotio illa quam oratiori necessario praemit-tendam censent.

p.29.l.22.Munditici in extremis corporis partibus ] Dictum à Mohammede بني الدين علي النظافة Fundata est Religio in munditie : & الطهور نصف الايمان mun-dities est dimidium fidei ; quæ ipsius dicta ut intelli-gantur quatuor statuit AlGazalius munditici {*} gra-dus, quorum primus est تطهير الظاهر عن الاحداث والاخباث والفضلات mundatio exterioris [corporis] ab inquinamento, rebusq; sordibus & superfluis. Secundus تطهير الجوارح عن الجرائم والاثام Mundatio membrorum corporis à sceleribus & rebus illicitis [patran-dis. ] Tertius تطهير القلب عن الاخلاق المذمومة والرذايل المعقوة Mundatio cordis à moribus vitupe-rio, & vitiis odio dignis. Quartus تطهير السر عما سوي الله تعالي Mundatio secreti ab omni re præter Deum, scil.intimorum cordis affectuum expurgatio quò Deo soli vacent, à multis من عميق بصيرته quorum caligant oculi, curari exteriorem illam corporis, quæ est cæteris كالقشر الاخضر بالاضافة الي اللب المطلوب instar corticis ætimi ad nucleum qui appetitur, cùm sit اهم الامور تطهير السر [?] Maximi momenti

page.notes: Marginal Arabic note at left beside "gradus": "* أربع مراتب" (partly unclear; the mark "*" in the text refers to it). Two left-margin notes carry the mark "*": "Ebnol Athir." and "AlGazal." Their order matches the text but the text marks are not separately distinguishable on the scan. Arabic lines are copied from a low-resolution scan; their word order and some letters are uncertain, especially "تطهير السر" in the last text line and the Arabic placed at the line ends. Left-margin entries "AlGazal. & Ebnol Athir." sit beside the paragraph opening "Munditici". The scan is faint at the left edge; a small stain is at the far left.
